### What does it do?

Inserts an empty paragraph when pressing enter while having the selection on an image

### Why is it needed?

Right now, pressing enter on an image deletes it. Reported on discord

### How to test it?

Create image, click it, press enter, new

When using the new Blog editor not able to add additional elements underneath the image element.

1. Go to the block visual editor
2. Click on image type
3. Scroll down bellow image and try to ad text

Should be able to add additional elements underneath the image
